label: estimated from imagery by the Wire Frame Scanner
note: One entry per public register farm. 'rows' names a lon/lat row file baked by the GPU lab: {rows: [[[lon,lat],[lon,lat]], ...], metres_per_pixel, sample_step_px, ...}. Register points are the public register's own point, not a survey.

point.source: DESNZ REPD Q2 2026 (July 2026 edition), point basis: retained Pipeline index; register coordinates, not a survey

site_area_m2.source: DESNZ REPD Q2 2026 site area field, as declared in the register

sample_step_px.source: GPU lab detect.py: runs sampled every 3 px across the row direction
